opportunities.title: CNCF Technical Advisory Group (TAG) 参与 — 工作组的公开贡献与领导力路径
prerequisites: 对某一云原生领域的兴趣
produces: 公开贡献记录（文档/评审/倡议）
TAG 领导层（Tech Lead/Chair）提名路径
opportunities.summary: CNCF TAG 是跨项目协调的技术顾问组；会议对公众开放，无需注册或会员资格即可参与讨论、评审文档、加入倡议，并沿 Path to Leadership 被提名进入领导层。
opportunities.notes: No registration or membership required - simply join and observe or participate. Path to Leadership: Start Contributing → Take on Tasks → Get Nominated (Chairs nominate Tech Leads; community elects Chairs).

application_status.evidence_summary: All TAG meetings are open to the public. No registration or membership required - simply join and observe or participate in discussions. Path to Leadership: Chairs nominate Tech Leads; community elects Chairs.

opportunities.title: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2027 CFP（演讲征集）
prerequisites: 云原生相关实践经验（演讲主题）
produces: 会议演讲（团队外可见度）
Senior 评审看重的影响力证据
opportunities.summary: KubeCon EU 2027 CFP 开放中，投稿截止 2026-10-11 CEST，会议 2027-03-15~18 于巴塞罗那。接受 Solo/Dual/Panel/Lightning/Poster/Tutorial。
opportunities.notes: Submissions are due by 11 October at 11:59 PM CEST. CFP Notifications 7 December. First-time speakers explicitly encouraged. Avoid AI-generated slop.

application_status.evidence_summary: Submissions are due by 11 October at 11:59 PM CEST (UTC+2). CFP Opens 2 September 2026; CFP Closes 11 October 2026; Event Dates 15-18 March 2027, Barcelona.

opportunities.title: Kubernetes SIG 贡献者路径（good first issue → contributor ladder）
opportunities.summary: Kubernetes 贡献完全开放、滚动进行：认领 good first issue，加入对应 SIG，沿 contributor ladder 上升。无需申请。
opportunities.notes: A SIG is an open, community effort. Anybody is welcome to jump into a SIG and begin fixing issues, critique design proposals, and review code. Browse issues labeled good first issue.

application_status.evidence_summary: A SIG is an open, community effort. Anybody is welcome to jump into a SIG... browse the issues labeled as a good first issue. No application required.

opportunities.title: CNCF 项目 Maintainer 路径（contributor ladder → OWNERS 提名）
prerequisites: 成为 CNCF 项目 contributor（先有 PR 合并）
opportunities.summary: CNCF 项目采用 contributor ladder：contributor → reviewer → maintainer，由现有 maintainer 通过 OWNERS 文件 PR 提名。这是升 Senior 最硬的 ownership 证据。
opportunities.notes: Document your contributor ladder - contributor, reviewer, and maintainer levels. Maintainer nominated by opening a PR adding the nominee as Approver in the OWNERS file; 2/3 current Maintainers approve.

application_status.evidence_summary: Adopt the CNCF contributor ladder - contributor, reviewer, and maintainer levels. Maintainer process: nominated via PR to OWNERS file, approved by 2/3 current Maintainers. Ongoing (rolling) via contribution.

opportunities.title: CNCF Ambassador 计划（年度申请）
prerequisites: CNCF SIG/TAG 成员 或 项目贡献
公开演讲 / 内容创作 / 社区组织（至少两项）
produces: CNCF 活动资源与差旅支持
opportunities.summary: CNCF Ambassador 年度申请，要求申请人在 SIG/TAG/贡献/演讲/社区组织等至少两项有实质参与。2026 周期已于 9 月发通知，新申请人需等 2027 窗口。
opportunities.notes: The program will accept applications for Ambassadors once a year; if you missed the application season, look out for the next. Application notifications sent the September after applications have closed. Term is two years (e.g., 2026-2028).

application_status.evidence_summary: The program will accept applications for Ambassadors once a year. Application notifications will be sent the September after applications have closed. 2026 cycle closed; next application window 2027.

opportunities.title: LFX Mentorship（CNCF）— 以 Mentor 身份参与（需项目 maintainer 资格）
prerequisites: CNCF 项目 maintainer 资格（才能以 mentor 身份提案项目）
opportunities.summary: LFX Mentorship 每年三学期；以 mentor 身份参与需先成为 CNCF 项目 maintainer 并提案。Term 3 2026 的 mentee 申请与 mentor 提案窗口均已关闭，下一轮 Term 1 2027 提案约 1 月开放。
opportunities.notes: Term 03 - 2026 Sep-Nov Status: Planning. Mentee Applications Open Aug 3 - Aug 18 (closed). Mentor project proposals Jul 1-28 (closed). Next mentor proposal window ~Term 1 2027 (proposals open ~Jan 2027).

application_status.evidence_summary: Term 03 - 2026 Sep-Nov Status: Planning. Mentee Applications Open Aug 3 - Aug 18; Mentor project proposals Jul 1-28 (both closed). Next window Term 1 2027.
